chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Ismail ibn Jabir who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said to me: 'Do not eat their slaughters, nor eat in their vessels, meaning the People of the Book'.
ai.seo_question: What is the Shia ruling on eating meat and using vessels of the People of the Book?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) explicitly prohibits consuming the meat of the People of the Book and using their vessels, reflecting the Shia view of ritual purity (taharah) in their food preparations. This ruling is often contextualized within the broader jurisprudential debate regarding whether the prohibition is due to the uncertainty of the slaughter method or the impurity (najis) of their vessels, distinguishing it from the general permissibility granted in Surah al-Ma'idah.
